ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER C

Letter C — Cat.

A quiet green cat for the letter C. Cats are household celebrities for small children — real ones, neighbour’s ones and the one in every second picture book.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does C say?

“c — kuh, like cat”

In cat, the letter c says kuh — the same sound k makes. C is a letter of many talents (it can borrow the s sound in words like circle), but cat keeps it simple.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Cat creep.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Creep around the room on hands and knees, whispering kuh, kuh, cat!

  2. 02

    Freeze when you reach a chair, then prowl on.

  3. 03

    End curled up in a cat nap together — two breaths is plenty.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
